description:
About the Scholarship

STEPS (Sustainable Transportation and Electric Power Systems) is an Erasmus Mundus joint master preparing engineers for the electrification of transport and the integration of renewable generation. The call for the September 2027 intake is open from 1 October 2026 until 8 January 2027, with Erasmus Mundus scholarships awarded on merit.

OpportunityEMJM STEPS – Sustainable Transportation and Electric Power Systems (Erasmus Mundus)
HostEMJM STEPS Consortium
LocationOviedo (multi-country mobility), Spain
Study LevelMaster's
FundingFully Funded
Stipend€1,400/month
Application Deadline8 January 2027
ApplyOfficial application page ↗

STEPS (Sustainable Transportation and Electric Power Systems) is an Erasmus Mundus joint master preparing engineers for the electrification of transport and the integration of renewable generation. The call for the September 2027 intake is open from 1 October 2026 until 8 January 2027, with Erasmus Mundus scholarships awarded on merit.

Programme Highlights

  • Study across three European universities with a joint master degree at the end
  • Focus on power electronics, grid integration and energy management for electric mobility
  • Erasmus Mundus scholarships cover tuition and pay around EUR 1,400 per month
  • Graduates move into grid operators, EV and rail industries, and energy research centres

Who Should Apply

Applicants should hold a bachelor's degree in electrical engineering, energy engineering or a close neighbouring field, with solid mathematics and power-systems fundamentals. English proficiency evidence is required in the standard Erasmus Mundus format.

Funding and Costs

Erasmus Mundus scholarship: tuition covered plus a monthly living allowance of EUR 1,400 for the two-year programme.

Deadline and How to Apply

Apply through the online form on the STEPS website before 8 January 2027; the consortium confirms results in spring for a September 2027 start. Key deadline information: 8 January 2027 (11:59 pm CET); applications opened 1 October 2026.

Official Link

  • Official application page (verified link)

About EMJM STEPS Consortium

The STEPS consortium delivers the Erasmus Mundus Joint Master in Sustainable Transportation and Electric Power Systems, coordinated from the University of Oviedo with European partner universities. Its graduates work on electrified mobility and modern power networks across three continents.

Official website: https://www.emjmdstepsrock.eu

Contact

Questions about this position, eligibility or the application process should be raised through the contact channel given on the official announcement page (see the Official Link section above). Always quote the position reference in your message so the admissions or HR team can route your enquiry quickly.

Important Notes

  • Application deadline: 8 January 2027 - late or incomplete applications are normally not considered.
  • Listing details were recorded from the official source at the time of publication; always confirm the latest requirements on the official page before applying.
  • Prepare the documents listed in the eligibility and application sections before starting the online form - transcripts, CV and references take the longest to collect.
